Table 4: Hardware configuration and chip area breakdown: SHARP8+ vs. WHET.

Figure 2: CtS/StC matrix decomposition [39] and plaintext compression simplified for 𝑁 = 32. The original dense CtS/StC matrix, composed of powers of 𝜁 = 𝑒𝜋𝑖/𝑁 , is decomposed into two sparse matrices with reduced #diag (16→ 4 & 7). Empty slots in each matrix represent zero values. The rightmost matrix contains diagonals with repetitions, allowing plaintext compression.
